title: Creamy Hot Chocolate (Milk & Half-and-Half)
headnote: DRAFT / UNTESTED. Recovered December 7, 2025 one-mug formula, deliberately made without heavy cream, using whole milk, half-and-half, and melted chocolate. No confirmed tasting review recovered.

ingredientGroups.title: One mug
items: 45 g semisweet chocolate chips (or dark chocolate at 60–70% cacao for less sweetness)
Optional: 10–15 g sugar or honey, to taste

steps: Warm the whole milk and half-and-half together in a small saucepan over medium-low heat until steaming but not boiling.
Add chocolate and salt and whisk continuously for 30–60 seconds, until completely melted and smooth.
Take off the heat and stir in optional vanilla. Taste first, then add optional sugar or honey if needed.
Pour into a mug and serve immediately.
